name: Insect Part Analysis
summary: In Gadgetzan, Fizzledowser needs word on the insect parts sent to Alchemist Pestlezugg. With Scrimshank lost, the Senior Surveyor is sorting his surveying gear and personal effects.

sections.title: A Check-In at Gadgetzan
sections.body: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser is putting Scrimshank's surveying gear and personal effects in order. He fears the bugs will claim more lives, so he sends you to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan. Learn whether Pestlezugg has finished processing the insect parts the surveyors sent. If they are ready, bring them back to Fizzledowser.

sections.title: What Pestlezugg Found
sections.body: Alchemist Pestlezugg has finished his work, and the results trouble him. He believes the first suspicion was right: an outside force controls the bugs. That points to a powerful force, unknown and malignant. Pestlezugg has never seen bugs changed into pure ravagers before.

faq.q: Who sends you to consult Alchemist Pestlezugg?
faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser sends you while sorting through Scrimshank's surveying gear and personal effects.
Alchemist Pestlezugg is in Gadgetzan, where you are sent to check on the insect parts.

faq.q: What came directly before this step?
faq.answer: The Scrimshank Redemption comes directly before this step.

faq.q: What are you sent to find out?
faq.answer: You are sent to learn whether Pestlezugg has finished processing the insect parts the surveyors sent. If they are ready, bring them back to Fizzledowser.
